title: Structure a Test Module
goal: Arrange the declaration and body of a unit test module.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Unit Tests

hints: Start by opening the test module with `#[cfg(test)]`.
Import parent items so that types used in function signatures (like Err) are resolved before declaring test functions.
explanation: The `#[cfg(test)]` attribute applies to `mod tests`. `use super::*;` must be at module level before function declarations so types in return type signatures like `Result<(), Err>` resolve correctly in module scope. Each test function needs `#[test]` directly above its signature.
